LESSON: ACIDS, BASES AND INDICATORS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Mixtures, Elements, and Compounds
Topic 2.2: Acids, Bases and Indicators

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Acids, Bases and Indicators
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why are acids and bases important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify acids and bases using a litmus paper
2. describe the physical properties of acids and bases
3. appreciate the uses of acids and bases in r eal life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

• Use safe examples only.

• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Acids, Bases and Indicators.

Try this

• Write 5 bullet facts about Acids, Bases and Indicators.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify acids and bases using a litmus paper
• describe the physical properties of acids and bases
• appreciate the uses of acids and bases in r eal life

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Acids, Bases and Indicators.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.
